description: YouTube video hooks for 2026. Focus: First 8 seconds, title optimization, problem-solution patterns.

voice_requirements.structure: Problem → Solution promise → Value preview in first 8 seconds

hook.opening_line: The biggest mistake [audience] make is...
hook.title: The Biggest Mistake [Audience] Make (And How to Fix It)

examples.why_it_works: Identifies common pain point immediately, promises solution in title

hook.opening_line: By the end of this video, you'll know exactly how to...
hook.title: How to [Desired Outcome] in [Timeframe] (Step-by-Step Guide)

examples.why_it_works: Clear promise upfront, specific outcome, actionable format

hook.opening_line: I built [impressive thing] in [timeframe]. Here's the result...
hook.title: I Built [Thing] in [Timeframe] - Here's What Happened

examples.why_it_works: Shows result first (pattern interrupt), creates curiosity about process

hook.opening_line: Everyone says [common advice]. But [contrarian truth].
hook.title: [Contrarian Take] That Nobody Talks About

examples.why_it_works: Challenges assumptions, positions as insider knowledge

hook.opening_line: This free AI tool replaces a $500/mo subscription. Let me show you exactly how.
hook.title: Free AI Tool That Replaces a $500/Month Subscription

examples.why_it_works: Specific dollar figure, free vs paid contrast, tutorial promise in opening line

hook.opening_line: I tested 47 AI tools over 6 months. 44 of them were garbage. These are the 3 I actually use every day.
hook.title: I Tested 47 AI Tools (Only 3 Are Worth It)

examples.why_it_works: Massive effort signal (47 tools), narrow result (3), daily use validation, honest filtering

hook.opening_line: I gave an AI agent access to my calendar, email, and to-do list. After 30 days, I got 11 hours back every week. Here's exactly what happened.
hook.title: I Let an AI Agent Run My Life for 30 Days (Saved 11 Hours/Week)

examples.why_it_works: Personal experiment, specific integrations, timeframe (30 days), tangible result (11 hours)

hook.opening_line: I replaced my $8K/mo team with $200/mo in AI tools. This is the exact stack and setup.
hook.title: How I Replaced My $8K/Month Team With AI ($200/Month)

examples.why_it_works: Dramatic cost contrast ($8K vs $200), exact stack promise, step-by-step expectation

hook.opening_line: Stop using ChatGPT like Google. Here's how power users actually prompt — and it changes everything.
hook.title: Stop Using ChatGPT Like Google (Power User Prompting Guide)

examples.why_it_works: Provocative correction, power user positioning, promises method upgrade

hook.opening_line: I automated my entire content pipeline — 30 posts per week with zero hours of manual work. The setup took 2 hours. Let me walk you through it.
hook.title: How I Automated 30 Posts/Week With Zero Manual Work (2-Hour Setup)

examples.why_it_works: Specific output (30 posts/week), zero manual work claim, setup time (2 hours), walkthrough promise

hook.opening_line: Everyone says 'just use AI' but nobody shows the actual setup. Today I'm showing you mine, step by step.
hook.title: The AI Setup Nobody Shows You (Complete Walkthrough)

examples.why_it_works: Calls out universal frustration, promises real walkthrough, gap in the market
